I am an old man in Iringa, and maize is what feeds my family. The rains here are good and my neighbors who put fertilizer get more bags from their plots, so I will buy one bag of CAN if the price is fair this season. I keep my own seed from last year because the shop seed is too expensive and I trust what grew well on my land before. My wife and I will do most of the work with the hoe, but for weeding I will call two young men for a few days because at my age the weeding is hard.
